dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Raoul arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Raoul has been noted to have a low threshold for arousal. Noted to jump up on handlers frequently and mount them. Raoul has also been observed to resource guard toy in his possession. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Raoul
